notes: Format-faithful synthetic bulk files for one election cycle (2026): weball26.zip (6 candidate rows: 5 valid across House/Senate/President plus 1 malformed CAND_ID that must be skipped), pas226.zip (10 contribution rows: 8 valid plus 2 malformed), cn26.zip and cm26.zip (masters covering most, deliberately not all, of the ids referenced above, to exercise both the join-hit and join-miss/null paths). See README.md in this directory for exactly how the row values were chosen and how the ZIPs were built.
